content: Even the gods cannot alter what has already been woven into the tapestry of the past.
author: Ancient Greek Proverbs
explanation: The ancient poet Agathon observed that of one thing alone even Zeus is deprived: the power to make undone that which has once been done. Cease fighting with yesterday's facts. Accept what is done, bow to the lesson, and claim the only domain you command: the living present.
practicalInsight: Mentally close the door on a past regret today. It cannot be altered by your tears; release it.
reflectionPrompt: How much vitality are you burning up attempting to rewrite or argue with a chapter that has already been written?
